label.zh: 论文原始 Figure 1 · 带出处

insight.zh: 核心构图不是单纯“仿真图变漂亮”，而是把可控输入、生成外观与保持不变的几何/动作关系明确对应。
insight.en: The key composition aligns controllable simulation inputs, generated appearance, and the geometry/action information that should remain consistent.

zh: 左侧展示仿真深度/机器人掩码等条件；右侧展示生成的 RGB 视频效果。
比较面板应共享任务、相机视角、对象或时刻，避免制造不公平对照。
少量标注区分生成的画面与真正拍摄的真实实验。
en: Contrast simulation depth and robot-mask conditions with generated RGB outcomes.
Align tasks, camera views, objects and time across comparison panels.
Clearly label generated imagery rather than passing it off as captured real-world results.

zh: 先固定真实论文要表达的唯一视觉主张。
选同一场景与同一时刻的输入、生成、真实参考（若有授权）三类证据。
按比较维度排列面板，caption 明确哪些是生成、哪些是实测。
en: State the one comparison your paper can actually support.
Choose matched input, generated and licensed real-reference conditions.
Align panels and distinguish synthetic and physical measurements in labels and captions.

zh: 不得从图片好看直接推导策略成功率，需要独立的实验结果。
当前主图为论文 Figure 1 的真实缩略预览，细节以原始论文或官方素材为准。
en: Image quality alone does not establish policy success; use separate results.
The primary preview is a reduced-size excerpt of the actual paper Figure 1; verify detail in the official source.
